outcomes.description: One user-facing LifeOS control surface shows current work, blockers, health, hosts and actionable controls.
Personal-assistant capabilities are surfaced through governed interfaces rather than ad-hoc scripts.
Homelab services, hosts and recovery capabilities are observable and governed through the control plane.
Energy state, forecasting and learning are exposed as a maintained LifeOS capability.
Stages 10 and 11 provide validated engineering and bounded self-improvement foundations.
Durable evidence, verification state and long-term operational memory remain attributable and auditable.
lifeos-platform remains the canonical implementation authority with runtime drift detection.
High-risk, destructive, financially consequential and ambiguous actions remain explicitly human-controlled.
